title: 2 Hour Sunset Private Music Boat Party With Captain
includes: Stereo - We can DJ or you can connect
Captain Fee | Per USCG Law For Groups Over 6 People Only | 100 USD Per Hour Due Upon Arrival (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Please Read - Additional Cost For Groups Of 7+ Passengers: Per US Coast Guard regulation, for groups of 7 or more passengers, the cost of the captain cannot be included in the charter fee and is not included in the amount paid at the time of booking. An additional 100 USD per hour is due upon arrival and must be paid directly to the captain via cash, Venmo or Zelle. This is only for groups of 7 or more passengers. For groups of 6 or less all costs are included at the time of booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Imagine yourself cruising across the glistening waters of Lake Tahoe, surrounded by stunning mountain views, as the sky turns vibrant shades of orange and pink. The Sunset Music Boat Party is the ultimate way to unwind and create unforgettable memories. Bring your favorite playlist, soak in the breathtaking views, and celebrate life while the sun dips behind the majestic Sierra Nevada mountains. This one-of-a-kind experience perfectly blends relaxation, music, and natural beauty, making it a must-do for both locals and visitors alike.
